topic: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres: Unveiling Conic Sections
target_audience: High school geometry or early undergraduate students

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Plane and the Cone
lecture_lines: Conic sections arise from slicing a cone.
Imagine a knife cutting through a cone.
animations: Fade in a 3D wireframe cone on black background (#000000).
Translate a semi-transparent plane (#FFFFFF) intersecting the cone.
Highlight the intersection curve in bright yellow (#FFFF00).

sections.title: Introducing Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres fit perfectly inside a cone.
They touch the cone in perfect circles.
They touch the cutting plane at points.
animations: Fade in a cone and a sphere (#FF0000, red) inside.
Show the sphere tangent to the cone and the plane.
Label the tangent point as the focus (#00FFFF, cyan).

sections.title: The Geometry of the Ellipse
lecture_lines: An ellipse forms by slicing one cone.
Points on the ellipse follow specific rules.
The sum of distances is always constant.
Foci are where the spheres touch.
This creates the classic elliptical shape.
animations: Show an ellipse intersection curve in orange (#FFA500).
Fade in two Dandelin spheres tangent to the plane.
Animate points on the ellipse moving towards the foci.
Highlight the sum of focal distances as constant value.
Flash the ellipse boundary to emphasize its geometric property.

sections.title: Transitions: Parabolas and Hyperbolas
lecture_lines: Changing the plane angle shifts the shape.
Slicing both cones creates a hyperbola.
animations: Show the plane parallel to a cone generator.
Animate the curve changing from ellipse to parabola.
Tilt the plane further to create a hyperbola.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres connect solids to geometry.
These tangency points are the foci.
Physics relies on these for planetary orbits.
animations: List key concepts: Ellipse, Parabola, Hyperbola on screen.
Color-code each conic section in a unique light color.
Fade out all elements into a unified summary screen.
